Class PetriSim

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.petriobj.PetriSim
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class PetriSim extends Object implements Cloneable, Serializable
This class is Petri simulator.
The object of this class simulates dynamics of functioning according to Petri net, given in his data field. Such object is named Petri-object.
Author:
Inna V. Stetsenko

    • getObjIndex

      public int getObjIndex()
      Position of this Petri-object in the object list of the PetriObjModel that owns it, assigned when the model is built.

      Unlike getNumObj(), which counts every Petri-object ever created in the JVM, this index is stable, zero-based and independent of how many simulations ran before. It is the index used to address a Petri-object in statistic formulas (O0.P1, O1.T2, …) and in PetriObjLink declarations.

      Returns:
      the zero-based index in the model, or UNASSIGNED_INDEX when this Petri-object is not part of a model

    • setObjIndex

    • setFiringListener

      public void setFiringListener(TransitionFiringListener listener)
      Installs the observer of this object's firings, or null to remove it.

      Called by PetriObjModel; a Petri-object never installs one on itself, which is what keeps a clone — built by clone() into a model that has no collector yet — from inheriting an observer that belongs to another run. A headless or Swing run leaves it null and pays one null check per firing.

      Parameters:
      listener - the observer of the four firing phases

    • step

      public void step()
      Do one event

      This is the standalone single-object loop, reached only from go(); a model drives its objects through input() and output() instead. It fires transitions directly and therefore reports no FiringPhase to a TransitionFiringListener.
